bibliographic.title: Northern Powerhouse: Last Towns Standing
bibliographic.author: Re-Dock, Young People of Wigan, Burnley, Hull
bibliographic.description:
The year is 2065. Wigan, Burnley and Hull are the only towns left in The North.

Wigan is a harsh place to live (after a nuclear explosion in the year 2035) with dead zones where technology doesn't work. Burnley is over run with robots, with an enslaved population of artificially created humans, but Hull is a pretty nice place to live as long as you work in the two main industries of advanced robotics or bioengineering.

It's still difficult to cross the Pennines.

Games by Eden, Mina, Kizzy (Hull), Sarfraz, Chloe, Bethany (Burnley), Cleo, Lauren, David, Sian (Wigan).
